change: Standalone dilated residual network on the log spectrogram of the same filtered, inversion-corrected, normalized recordings. Waveform augmentation is off. Training uses spectrogram time and frequency masks, the cosine schedule, and fold-ensemble test scoring.
note: The spectrogram model learns a real rhythm signal, but both cross-validation and the locked test stay well below the waveform model. AF and Other fall the most, and the remaining mistakes are still Normal/Other and AF/Other.
